digest.component_or_area: Plan-review clarity gate and validation framework
propositions: A deterministic clarity floor should retain only hard rules that reject structurally unexecutable plans, validated against historical closed tickets with both plan-review and completion attestations.
Nonempty parsed acceptance-criteria checkbox items must be retained as a hard floor; exact duplicate AC text should be advisory only, not a hard failure.
Unresolved sentinel detection (TBD/TODO/FIXME/???) must narrow to structural value-assignment forms in exact active execution sections with removal/negation assertions suppressed.
File-impact and rebar citation validation belong to write-schema and grounding subsystems respectively, not to the raw clarity score.
Historical counterexample search found no violations of the narrowed sentinel rule, duplicate AC rule disproved by ticket 8d27, and rebar transitive references disproved by tickets 6673 and 94f9.
